name: diagnostic-logging
description: DIAGNOSTIC BUILD - turns on the application's own logging, which is compiled in but stubbed out. Every log call site in the image tests a global and, when logging is off, calls `dummyLogMsg` instead of `Log_msg`. `dummyLogMsg` is literally `li r3,0 ; blr`, so replacing that one instruction with a branch to the real `Log_msg` makes every one of those call sites live. One instruction, no code cave, trivially reversible. Intended for establishing whether a DBUS message is reaching the media app; expect a lot of output and do not drive on it. NAV only for now - the other builds need their own addresses checked before they are listed here.

patches.why: dummyLogMsg (li r3,0 ; blr) -> b Log_msg @ 0x02742558. Log_msg takes r3=level, r4=format and the caller has already set those, so the branch passes them straight through and every gated log site in the image becomes live.
